messages:
mike: Hey team — proposed cutover for ORION tenant to Dedicated on Thu 2026-04-02 02:00-03:30 UTC. Can we do quick go/no-go? Change window 90m. Rolling canary first 5% traffic for 15m -> 50% -> 100%.

anita: Customer (Orion Health) approved the window, asked to limit latency impact. They've agreed to 90m and will have on-call ready.

devon: Network peering checklist done? I ran the script, both VPC routes in place. /cc @mike

sara: SLOs: target p50 < 120ms, p95 < 400ms. Canary monitors: infra latency, model error rate, 5 golden prompts. Rollback triggers: >3% error spikes or p95>800ms for 5m.

mike: Version pin: rwinf-infer@v2.3.1-quant verified. Fallback: rwinf-infer@v2.2.9 (non-quant) — will automatically route if GPU OOMs.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @mike for 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z. Change ID: CHG-20260402-ORION-01. Canary config: 5%/15m. Rollout steps: canary -> 25% -> 100%.

anita: Is there a customer-facing maintenance message? I can send 15m prior heads-up.

mike: Yes please. Suggested blurb:
"Orion Health: scheduled maintenance for model cutover on Apr 2 02:00 UTC. Expected duration 90m. Some requests may see brief latency changes."

devon: I'll standby to run the health-check commands and toggle routing. Snippet:
```
# health check
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://private-api.orion/health | jq .status
```

sara: Also add a smoke test set after 25% step. I'll watch evals dashboard and post results.

mike: Ok. Approvals?

anita: +1 from customer.

devon: +1 ops

sara: +1 SRE

deploy-bot: change CHG-20260402-ORION-01 marked APPROVED by 3 reviewers. Preparing preflight checks.

deploy-bot: preflight passed. 0 issues. Ready to start at 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z.

mike: Go for launch. I'll post rollbar/incident channel link live if anything pops.

anita: I'll send the customer heads-up 15m before.

sara: Monitoring now, will call rollback on threshold triggers.

deploy-bot: update: rollout started. Canary at 5%.

sara: Canary p50 110ms p95 350ms, golden prompts OK.

deploy-bot: progressing -> 25%.

devon: post-25% smoke checks green.

sara: p95 jumped to 620ms for 2m then back. Not breaching rollback rule (needs 5m). Continue to 100%.

deploy-bot: rollout complete 100%. Change closed. CHG-20260402-ORION-01 SUCCESS.

mike: Nice job. Follow-ups: record notes in release notes doc and schedule post-mortem 48h if we see regressions.

anita: Customer ops confirmed no service impact observed.

sara: Adding a note: revisit quantized runtime perf on this tenant, small p95 bump during 25% -> 100% may need kernel tweak.

mike: Filed RFD and assigned to eng-runtime. Closing thread.
